title: VendPoint Category Table: Wear Allowance on a Substitute's Settling Par
content:
Category table of the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program for the settling par of a Corbett-placed substitute in its first three months.

The wear allowance follows the product category on the substitute's add entry: an item in the safety and PPE category carries the PPE wear allowance, an item in the cutting tools or the abrasives category carries the consumable wear allowance, and any other item carries none.

| Category on the substitute's add entry | Wear allowance |
|---|---|
| Safety and PPE | 0.5 |
| Cutting tools or abrasives | 0.25 |
| Other categories | None |

The add entry read is the substitute's own add entry in the machine's selection history. Hypothetical: a substitute safety vest added under safety and PPE carries 0.5; a substitute cable tie added under electrical carries none.
